question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a green ball, Eve has a silver ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Dave swap balls. Finally, Bob and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) white ball
(C) purple ball
(D) green ball
(E) silver ball
(F) grey ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (teal, white, purple, green, silver, grey, pink)
1. Dave and Gertrude swap: (teal, white, purple, pink, silver, grey, green)
2. Dave and Claire swap: (teal, white, pink, purple, silver, grey, green)
3. Eve and Gertrude swap: (teal, white, pink, purple, green, grey, silver)
4. Eve and Claire swap: (teal, white, green, purple, pink, grey, silver)
5. Dave and Bob swap: (teal, purple, green, white, pink, grey, silver)
6. Alice and Dave swap: (white, purple, green, teal, pink, grey, silver)
7. Bob and Fred swap: (white, grey, green, teal, pink, purple, silver)
Alice has the white ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
